THE NEW LARGEST GAP, which I found this round and which no earlier round names: the onboarding flow silently inverts an operator's weekday scope from 'no days' to 'every day' and writes it as a money-pricing agency condition. Measured from the screen, not from curl: open קליטת לקוח, pick an existing agency, type 12 in אחוז הנחה מהתוספת, click the one active weekday chip so that zero chips are selected, tick החילו ככלל סוכנות כדי שיתמחר תשדירים, submit. What actually lands in data/agency_conditions.csv is AGY_14,CMP_010_DISCOUNT,ANY,ANY,ANY,ANY,ANY,premium,12.0,premium_discount. scope_weekdays is ANY, which is every day of the week. The contrast is exact and one chip apart: with שבת selected the same submit stores AGY_14,CMP_012_DISCOUNT,ANY,ANY,ANY,ANY,6,premium,12.0,premium_discount. Same percent, opposite meaning, and nothing on the screen or in the confirmation discloses the widening. The chain is kairos_api/campaigns_api_onboarding.py:328-336 passing payload.surcharge_weekdays or '' into _apply_agency_discount at :173-186, which hands it to ConditionCreate, where kairos_api/condition_validation.validate_weekday_scope calls normalize_scope('') and normalize_scope returns ANY. An empty string means 'the operator chose nothing' at the surface and 'match everything' in the engine, and P4 is the seam that joins those two readings without noticing. It is inert on today's data only by accident: I measured all 119 priced spots on /api/clients/money and every one carries premium exactly 1.0, so a premium_discount has nothing to take a percent off, and gross 699,450 net 669,978 did not move when I wrote a 50 percent empty-scope rule onto AGY_02 which owns 51 of those spots. The moment a premium above 1.0 exists this rule starts discounting every day for every campaign bought through that agency, with no further change to P4. The milder half of the same bug, which the round-8 critic did report and which round 9 did not fix, is that the campaign row also stores surcharge_discount_percent 12.0 beside an empty surcharge_weekdays, a term that scopes nothing, accepted silently. One pass fixes both halves at the one seam: refuse or explicitly restate an empty weekday scope in campaigns_api_onboarding.py before it becomes ANY, and in tv-break-dashboard/src/clients/OnboardClientFlow.jsx say on the fieldset which days the rule will cover as the chips change, rather than only which campaigns it will cover. I checked the cause: kairos.data.loaders.load_spots returns 12 columns and advertiser_id is not one of them, so campaigns_read.py:67 backfills it with an empty string, groups on it and renders an all-empty column. That is a placeholder where the honest-empty-state rule demands a named absence. Either say why the column is empty the way the revenue note does, or drop the column. The campaign rollup that P4 keeps inside the Clients destination (kairos_api/campaigns_read.py::_build_campaigns, rendered by tv-break-dashboard/src/clients/CampaignRollupPanel.jsx) groups the whole spots frame with no operator-channel filter, while the money board two panels above it on the same screen is correctly scoped to settings.operator_channel. The repository already states the doctrine that forbids this at kairos_api/core.py:460-476, in the summary function's own docstring, and campaigns_read.py never applies it.
